notes.title: Devlog #21: We Need Your Feedback – Masks of the Void: Origins! – September 17th
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]Hi, Gamers! [/p][p][/p][p]Tina here—Social Media Expert and Host at RolldBox Games. Today, I’m chatting with Ferran, one of our Co-Founders, as well as the Game Designer and Creative Director of the studio at RolldBox Games 👋[/p][p][/p][p]After 20 posts sharing how we’re building [b][i]Masks of the Void[/i][/b], we think it’s time to dedicate one to you—[b]the gamers[/b].[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]Why? Because your feedback is absolutely crucial. Getting it helps us evolve and grow the game, so the experience is as exciting and engaging as it can be.[/p][p align="justify"][/p][p align="justify"]That’s our mission: to build with depth, with content, and to make sure you have a blast playing![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Inside the Development Process[/b][/h3][p]
[u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2542350/view/521974992851698380?l=spanish"]In our last devlog[/url][/u], we gave you a sneak peek at [b]how important playtests are for us[/b] and what we usually look at.[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]Today, we’re diving in a bit deeper! 💬[/p][p align="justify"][/p][p align="justify"]We run [b]multiple playtests[/b], with [b]different people[/b] and [b]different focuses[/b], zeroing in on elements like:[/p][list][*][p]The [b]art[/b], and how clearly it communicates what we want 🖌️
[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]gameplay[/b], its progression, and overall flow 🎯
[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]user interface[/b] and how intuitive it feels 🖱️
[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]onboarding phase[/b] and how it’s perceived 🚪
[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]game’s essence[/b], and how it unfolds 🗝️[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]… Plus many more insights we uncover just by watching you play!

And of course—we also play ourselves. Our dev team runs internal sessions with different goals, giving each other constructive cross-discipline feedback, so we can keep leveling up the experience.[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/9787214803a3e15ec528a03081f3922f849ff215.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"]We iterate – we test – we iterate – we test…[/p][p align="justify"][/p][p align="justify"]And in this cycle, everyone who’s taken part has helped us move forward in a big way.[/p][p align="justify"][/p][p align="justify"]So—[b]thank you for that[/b]! 👥❤️[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/9f044f19c4d440281e79ff1e16051bf85c713d5a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Sneak Peek of Upcoming Content[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The characters bring the story behind the game to life—and one of the key figures in [b][i]Masks of the Void[/i][/b] is the [b][i]Tyrant[/i][/b].[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]Who is he? Why is he here? What is his kingdom like?[/p][p align="justify"][/p][p align="justify"]You’ll uncover it piece by piece as you play, but here’s a little glimpse:[/p][p align="justify"][b][i]The Tyrant has been shaped by an iron will stemming from his childhood slavery[/i][/b].[/p][p align="justify"]What did he endure? What happened to him? His past has carved the path to his future! 🌕[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/cede10179dd9119dc727259620e2d322bfaa2759.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]More to share[/b] [/h3][p][/p][p][b]We’re indie, and we love sharing the creation process[/b] so you can live the full experience—from concept to final result.[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]Follow us and don’t hesitate to drop your thoughts: what you like most, or anything you think matters about what we share. 📌[/p][p align="justify"][/p][p align="justify"]We can’t wait for you to play it yourself soon and give us feedback straight from your own experience![/p][p]In the meantime, [b]add us to your wishlist—and get your friends to do the same[/b]![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]See you in the next Devlog with more and better![/p][p][/p][p]Don’t forget to [url="https://discord.com/invite/masksofthevoid"]join our Discord server[/url]. Let us know what you’d like us to talk about next from there!

[b]
See you in the Void![/b]

[/p]

notes.title: Devlog #20: Feel the Game: Masks of the Void: Origins! – September,4th 2025
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]Hi, Gamers! [/p][p][/p][p]Tina here—Social Media Expert and Host at RolldBox Games. Today, I’m chatting with Ferran, one of our Co-Founders, as well as the Game Designer and Creative Director of the studio at RolldBox Games 👋[/p][p][/p][p]Welcome to [b]DEVLOG #20[/b]: 20 [i]DevDiaries[/i] diving into different aspects of game creation, from conception to full development. After months of work—from ideation to finished build—there’s definitely a lot to share.[/p][p][/p][p]This time, we'd like to give a special shout-out to two areas that are essential to the game, so you can [b]fully experience it[/b]. Let’s dive in![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Inside the Development Process[/b][/h3][p]
[b]🔹 The Soundtrack and Sound Effects![/b][/p][p align="justify"]We had the special collaboration of amazing professionals from the game industry, who’ve created sounds and soundtracks for top AAA studios. These are top-tier pros who want to support and work with indie studios, helping us shine even brighter. We can’t thank them enough for their talent and dedication.[/p][p align="justify"][/p][p align="justify"][b]How did we create the soundtrack?[/b] [/p][p align="justify"]For every area and environment, we asked ourselves what we wanted you to feel in the game: the rhythm, the intensity, the immersive atmosphere. We talked about instruments, voices, examples, emotions, and moods. This is the hardest part—putting into words what you want the sound to express. [/p][p align="justify"]What helps the most are the game visuals in each environment, paired with varied gameplay moments. Then came the recordings, drafts, and tweaks to craft an epic soundtrack that we hope you enjoy as much as the entire dev team loved creating it.[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"][/p][p align="justify"][b]And the sound effects?[/b] [/p][p align="justify"]A clear description of what we wanted to convey in every action and moment. Again, lots of gameplay footage was key, along with a huge list of sounds, and the magic of our amazing sound professional guided us so you can [b]experience and feel every single telekinetic move and throw in [i]Masks of the Void: Origins[/i]![/b][/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]Have fun! 🔊[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/6bd3b3050bdf8d4f3e432fb64ff734f8e13062a8.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Sneak Peek of Upcoming Content[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]When it comes to [b][i]Feeling[/i][/b], one of the most important parts for us is all the playtests we run.[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]🔹 We want to give a [b]big thanks to all the participants for their contributions and feedback[/b], which we truly value. [/p][p align="justify"]Being able to spot what works and what doesn’t is part of our job, and watching how people play—what draws them in, what doesn’t, what’s easy to understand and what’s tricky, their level of fluency, and countless other things we observe—helps us make a better game![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/db7bbb376be4a61c20cfa0e9879ea6a246713683.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]More to share[/b] [/h3][p][/p][p]Your opinion matters to us! Right now we’re in the wishlist phase before the game launches, but once it’s out, your reviews on the experience are a gift to us—so we welcome them with open arms![/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy [b][i]Masks of the Void: Origins[/i]: Wishlist it, follow us, and share it with your friends[/b] — especially if you love indie games and bold new ideas. ⭐[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]See you in the next Devlog with more and better![/p][p][/p][p]Don’t forget to [url="https://discord.com/invite/masksofthevoid"]join our Discord server[/url]. Let us know what you’d like us to talk about next from there!

[b]
See you in the Void![/b]

[/p]

notes.title: Devlog #19: Surprises from The Neverending Night! – August 19th, 2025
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]Hi, Gamers! [/p][p][/p][p]Tina here—Social Media Expert and Host at RolldBox Games. Today, I’m chatting with Cris, the Art Director of the studio at RolldBox Games 👋[/p][p][/p][p]We’re already sharing gameplay from [i][b]Masks of the Void: Origins[/b][/i]! Across different times, different days, and even in other languages! 🌐[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]It won’t be long before you can enjoy the full experience. There’s still so much to discover — and in the meantime, we’ll keep showing you behind-the-scenes details of its creation and development.[/p][p align="justify"][/p][p align="justify"]Enjoy it![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Inside the Development Process[/b][/h3][p]
[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2542350/view/521973089872904398?l=spanish"][u]In our previous Devlog[/u][/url], we gave you a [b]sneak peek of our [i]Void[/i] character from [i]The Neverending Night[/i] and what its colors represent[/b]. [/p][p][/p][p]Now, we’ll dive a bit deeper into how we got there:[/p][p align="justify"][/p][p align="justify"]When we first began imagining [i]The Void[/i], we drew inspiration from a wide range of media — from games like [i]Hades[/i] to galaxy images captured by our satellites, and even Marvel movies like [i]The Avengers[/i].[/p][p align="justify"][/p][p align="justify"]We chose shades of purple, mainly inspired by stellar nebulae, aiming to represent that vast space in [i]The Void[/i], charged with raw power. We truly believe [b]purple embodies power[/b], as we hinted at in [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2542350/view/521973089872904398?l=spanish"][u]last week’s Devlog[/u][/url].[/p][p align="justify"][/p][p align="justify"]From the very beginning, we wanted to avoid reddish tones, so players wouldn’t feel an immediate, physical threat. Instead, we wanted them to be [b]drawn to the warmth of the soft violets[/b], blended with cooler shades to heighten that feeling of calm before the storm.[/p][p][/p][p]Get drawn into [i]The Void[/i]! 😈[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/ae84276c1f6f92f00eac2ee26ec07b401e7d66e6.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Sneak Peek of Upcoming Content[/b]
[/h3][p][/p][p]Sound is a [b]core element[/b] for us in [i][b]Masks of the Void[/b][/i], from the [b]sound effects[/b] to the [b]original soundtrack[/b].[/p][p align="justify"][/p][p align="justify"]Every sound effect enhances each part of the game — every movement, every decision, every consequence — and conveys the dynamic energy you bring to the game with your play style.[/p][p align="justify"][/p][p align="justify"]The soundtrack is there with you the whole time, shifting subtly across maps and areas, amplifying the mood and atmosphere of each environment we’ve crafted.[/p][p align="justify"][/p][p align="justify"]We’re proud to have [b]top-tier[/b],[b] AAA-level professionals[/b] behind both aspects of the audio, helping bring our vision to life![/p][p][/p][p]Once we share the [b]credits list[/b], you’ll get to see all of them! 🎶[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/b5a69237ee82f5f1d0972c6bc7f92da9d2bfb943.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]More to share[/b] [/h3][p][/p][p]To enjoy [i][b]Masks of the Void: Origins[/b][/i], just [b]wishlist it, follow us, and share it with your friends[/b] — especially if you love indie games and bold new ideas. ⭐[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]We’re working hard to deliver a [b]fascinating and fun Roguelite[/b], which you can even play as a Roguelike if you prefer. It’s up to you — [b]what style do you want to play?[/b][/p][p]
[/p][p][/p][p]See you in the next Devlog with more and better![/p][p][/p][p]Don’t forget to [url="https://discord.com/invite/masksofthevoid"]join our Discord server[/url]. Let us know what you’d like us to talk about next from there!

[b]
See you in the Void![/b]

[/p]

notes.title: Devlog #18: Our Journey into the Void – August 6th, 2025
notes.content:
[p]Hi, Gamers! [/p][p][/p][p]Tina here—Social Media Expert and Host at RolldBox Games. Today, I’m chatting with Cris, the Art Director of the studio at RolldBox Games 👋[/p][p][/p][p][b]The [i]Masks of the Void[/i] franchise has arrived — and you can find all the details on our website![/b][/p][p][/p][p]On Steam, we’ll be launching [i][b]Masks of the Void: Origins[/b][/i] very soon, and we’re thrilled to share its content, the behind-the-scenes details of how we built it, and some sneak peek images revealing just a fraction of the work that went into it.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re also preparing a ton of [i]Making Of[/i] videos so you can dive even deeper into the process. And soon, the creators of [i][b]Masks of the Void[/b][/i] will be sharing their own gameplay experience with you![/p][p][/p][p]Sound exciting? Stay tuned and keep following us to get all the updates right on time! 🔔[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Inside the Development Process[/b][/h3][p]
[/p][p]In our previous devlog, we shared a few details about [i]The Void[/i]’s decoration. You might be wondering: [b]how did we decide to represent [i]The Void[/i]?[/b][/p][p][/p][p]The answer has at least two sides — [b]the artistic approach, and the design of the game’s narrative and mechanics[/b]. We chose shades of purple, inspired mainly by stellar nebulas, to capture that vast, force-charged space within the emptiness. We believe [b]purple [/b]embodies power, as it’s often associated with royalty, wisdom, creativity, mystery, and magic. 💜[/p][p][/p][p]From the very beginning, [b]we wanted to steer away from reddish tones so that the player wouldn’t feel an immediate, physical threat[/b]. Instead, we aimed for them to be drawn in by the warmth of soft violets, blended with cooler tones to amplify that [i]calm before the storm[/i] feeling.[/p][p][/p][p]As we’ve explained before, [i][b]The Void[/b][/i][b] causes your world to deconstruct, decay, and slowly fade away. [/b][/p][p][b]That’s exactly what’s happening to [i]Iret [/i]— [i]The[/i] [i]Boreal Island[/i] where she lives is the last remnant of her world[/b], and only on her journey to [i]The Vortex[/i] will she uncover what’s happening, how it all works… and face [i]The Void[/i] in its entirety.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/520b177ea2a5a44f133b54c6750e2350dd788829.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We won’t spoil anymore — play it yourself and uncover the secrets of [i]The Void[/i] and the [i]Masks[/i].[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Sneak Peek of Upcoming Content[/b]
[/h3][p]And who’s the ruler of [i]The Void[/i]? The entity itself — [b]The [i]Neverending Night[/i][/b]![/p][p][/p][p]As we mentioned before, with purple representing power, we also saw how it ties into spirituality, intuition, and imagination — making it the perfect match for our [i]Neverending Night[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]So… what does the [i]Neverending Night[/i] transform? [b]It doesn’t just feed on the raw energy of worlds — it channels this energy through the [i]Masks[/i], turning it into [i]Void Energy[/i][/b].[/p][p][/p][p]And what does it do with it?[/p][p][b]What do you imagine it could unleash in the life-and-death cycle of your world? 🌌 [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/e46a7025623f83149b7534087c2d438510b7d0a8.png"][/img][/p][p]Uncover it in the game![/p][p][/p][h3][b]More to share[/b] [/h3][p][/p][p]Remember — each [i][b]Mask[/b][/i] comes with unique traits, letting you try out different abilities and new ways to unleash your telekinesis.[/p][p][/p][p]So… based on what we’ve told you, which one would you choose?[/p][p][/p][p]The order in which you can obtain them is designed to help you discover their full potential — and truly appreciate their powers.[/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy [i][b]Masks of the Void[/b][/i]… and all its energy![/p][p]
[/p][p][/p][p]See you in the next Devlog with more and better![/p][p][/p][p]Don’t forget to [url="http://bit.ly/MoVDiscord"][u]j[/u][/url][url="https://discord.com/invite/masksofthevoid"]oin our Discord server[/url]. Let us know what you’d like us to talk about next from there!

[b]
See you in the Void![/b]

[/p]

notes.title: Devlog #12: Secrets of the Sand – May 13th, 2025
notes.content:

We can’t wait for you to experience the full version soon!

[h2][b]Inside the Development Process[/b][/h2]

We’ve been talking about enemies for a while, and in our latest devlog we introduced Ranged—one of the Sand Guards you’ll have to face.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/5f2a174202f19929cb7becc2ccff0c37afdab070.gif[/img]

Hi, Gamers! 

Tina here—Social Media Expert and Host at RolldBox Games. Today, I’m chatting with Cris, the Art Director of the studio at RolldBox Games 👋

The art in a video game is insanely complex, and we have to consider many aspects to make sure it hits the mark on the[b] story[/b] we want to tell, the [b]game feeling[/b] we want to create, and that it fully matches the intended [b]gameplay[/b]. Today, we’re pulling back the curtain to give you a closer look at the details!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/65e3ff9d44ab430c3cf3120a94edd531912ed7ee.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Inside the Development Process[/b][/h2]

As we mentioned in [i]Devlog #7[/i], we covered the throwable objects. Today, we’re diving into how we make them both “breakable” and “throwable”:

To give all [b]throwable objects[/b] a realistic feel, placing their pivot point at the center of mass is crucial, considering their shape to figure out where the weight naturally balances. [i]Blender[/i] came in clutch here, as it has a built-in feature to set the pivot point at the center of mass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/0ebe52bd4155dfae3e01985a891d3c284cdcb6c1.png[/img]

For [b]breakable and throwable props[/b], making sure the pivot is as centered as possible was essential. While using [i]Unreal[/i]’s destruction system, the generated pieces would keep their pivot in the center. [b]But not all objects used Unreal’s system—we crafted the pieces by hand[/b], like bones, to make sure the way they broke into parts made sense.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/18685cefd71f10b7e7bfb1c1e8db7f04fecf8399.png[/img]

[b][h2]Sneak Peek of Upcoming Content[/h2][/b]

Iret's capes, the design, creation, and animation process, have evolved several times. Here’s how we animated them:

We’re all about showing that they have a lot of bones because we want their movement to be superfluid, and that meant animating the capes by hand for each animation, which took a lot of time. To optimize it, [b]we decided to use [i]Unreal[/i]’s physics system for most animations, allowing them to move more organically with Iret’s body[/b]. For some specific animations, like the basic and special attacks with the different masks, where we needed the capes to have more complex movements, we spent extra time hand-animating them to get the exact movement we wanted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/5be9f07c106d8d374066ec54ea1c5ccf3ee11f31.gif[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #1: What we do with Masks of the Void – December 20th, 2024
notes.content:
Hi, Gamers!

Tina here—Social Media Expert and Host at RolldBox Games. Today, I’m chatting with Ferran, one of our Co-Founders, as well as the Game Designer and Creative Director of the studio. 👋

After working on this project for a long time and with the release of the DEMO, we’re excited to share what’s being done to bring the development process to completion. We’ll keep sharing tidbits with you so you can get a sneak peek behind the scenes. Let’s get started!
That’s why we’re thrilled to share insights into the production of [b][i]Masks of the Void[/i][/b], from the unique perspectives of our team members.

[h2][b]Inside the Development Process[/b][/h2]

As we progress in the development of [b][i]Masks of the Void[/i][/b], we’ve been working on several features and want to create a space for you to catch a glimpse of what’s in the works and how it’s evolving.
One thing we were excited to share, for example, is the evolution of the UI and how it has changed over time through playtesting. Among all the UI elements, the upgrades screen stands out—the one that allows IRET to develop its power during a run. This UI has undergone several changes, as we’ve been simplifying and refining it over time, such as:

[b]1st Iteration[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/0f7eb9df109dced6019bb3c7db7060e863551b84.png[/img]

[b]2nd iteration[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/b359690607ae52b40edadeb7b9d311001eedfe40.png[/img]

[b]And now it looks like:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/92aa3684c1ee950d2eeaebb3744ade52dc401924.png[/img]

Developing this UI was a massive effort, trying to balance letting the player know what can be done without overwhelming them with too many buttons. We ended up placing all the options on the same screen, with an unbalanced distribution, to let players know they can develop IRET and also perform some secondary actions with the Energy.



[b][h2]Sneak Peek of Upcoming Content[/h2][/b]

In every Devlog, we will be showing some of the upcoming details of the game as part of the full development of [b][i]Masks of the Void[/i][/b]. For today’s opening blog, we are delighted to share what the Void realm looks like! Have you ever wondered where the Cultists come from?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342879/c3e61b83f2b2340ad1d8df7529667e906c4a1ebb.png[/img]

[b][h2]More to share[/h2][/b]

In the demo, you can already practice with two masks! 

Reach the end of the story, and you’ll unlock a second one: [b]the Blood mask[/b], where you’ll discover new forms of telekinesis. Give it a try and let us know what you think!

See you in the next Devlog with more and better!

Don’t forget to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/hyQ5p3qNwe]Discord server[/url]! Let us know what you’d like us to talk about next from there!

See you in the Void!
